content_metadata.description: A man shares insights on the Metabolist movement by discussing a book titled 'Project Japan: Metabolism Talks' while engaging with the audience in an intellectual setting.

qAndA.answer: He calls it the 'first non-Western avant-garde' and suggests it prefigures trends in the 21st century.
qAndA.question: How does the man describe the Metabolist movement?

qAndA.answer: He seems genuinely intrigued by the Metabolist movement as something outside his own work, indicating a broader passion for architectural history and a desire to learn and share.

youtube_description:
See more architecture and design movies at http://www.dezeen.com/movies

In this interview that we filmed at the opening of OMA/Progress at the Barbican in London, OMA partner Reinier de Graaf talks about the architecture firm's current preoccupations, including the city of London.

OMA co-founder Rem Koolhaas gave Dezeen a private tour of the OMA/Progress exhibition, which ran from 6 October 2011 until 19 February 2012.

Watch this movie on Dezeen: http://www.dezeen.com/2011/10/13/dezeen-screen-rem-koolhaas-on-project-japan/
